notes: Governing documents for faculty leave are saved (HR Policies 6.27, 6.05 and 6.45, applying to faculty and staff; Faculty Rule 3335-6-03), so missing is false (the rule for records with no governing document does not apply).

2018_00_link is the Parental Care Guidebook 'Revised 10/01/18', describing the Policy 6.27 revision of 2018-10-01, after the reference date; its parental-leave description is recorded as c17 (not_yet_effective) and every in-force provision is coded from 2018_01-2018_07. 2018_03 (guidebook Revised 07/01/13) is a summary ('meant to be explanatory and does not replace current policies'); details it adds are noted per component.

Calendar: semesters ('the first day of autumn semester', OAA Faculty Appointments; 'each semester of leave without pay', Policy 6.45); no term length stated, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Chain, birth parent: parental leave 6 work weeks (c1, 240 hours, FMLA c3 concurrent from the start; optional employee-paid STD c11 pays from day 31 within the parental-leave span) -> own sick leave up to 30 working days (c2, consecutive_after c1, within the 12 FMLA weeks) -> discretionary unpaid medical leave up to 6 months (c4, consecutive_after c2). FMLA 12 workweeks runs alongside from the start of c1.

Chain, non-birth parent: parental leave 3 work weeks (c1, 120 hours) with FMLA 12 workweeks (c3) concurrent from the start; the remaining 9 FMLA weeks are paid only from vacation (12-month faculty, c13) or compensatory time, otherwise unpaid. Sick leave is not available for the birth to a parent eligible for parental leave (c2).

Paths not coded (U8): members not eligible for parental leave (under one year of service or 1,560 hours) may use sick leave (birth mother as medically documented; other parent up to 10 working days); birth mothers not eligible for FML are described by the 2013 guidebook as entitled to an unpaid medical leave for recovery (typically 6-8 weeks).

College of Arts and Sciences modified duties (c10) are scope-limited (V3b: one college) and not counted; the university-wide policy sets the figures (V3c). Its rule that leave plus modified duties may not exceed one semester is linked by c1 'within' c10 and flagged, not recorded in leave_limits (a record-level limit would also cap faculty outside the College; reported as a rule question).

Not components: adoption assistance (reimbursement of up to $5,000 of adoption expenses: not time off, pay or protection); jury duty and organ donation leave (not usable for a birth); professional and entrepreneurial unpaid leave (to take a position elsewhere); stillbirth parental leave (two weeks, noted in c1); FML temporary transfer to an equivalent position to accommodate intermittent leave (6.05 IV.C, noted with c3).
